requirement: Track and refill a missed load
test_behavior: The fixed upstream load test supplies demand reads whose cold accesses require cache-line acquisition.

requirement: Track independent missed loads and return their refill data
test_behavior: The added program issues eight loads from distinct 64-byte cache lines. Their destination values remain visible in the retired trace without controlling the pass path, so refill or response corruption is observable after normal completion.

requirement: Track stores that interact with a missed line
test_behavior: The fixed upstream store test supplies writes whose cold accesses require cache-line acquisition.

requirement: Serialize atomic operations with refill state
test_behavior: The fixed upstream atomic tests exercise read-modify-write and reservation traffic through the cache miss machinery.

requirement: Preserve modified data when evicting a cache line
test_behavior: The program stores distinct values to sixteen lines mapping to one eight-way set and reads back every value. Its completion is independent of the reloaded values, which are checked in the retired trace.
